Imaan waalo! Khabardaar Khuda o Rasool ke saamne apni baat ko aage na badhaao aur Allah se daro, beshak Allah har baat ka sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar apni aawaaz ko Nabi ki aawaaz par buland na karna aur un se is tarah buland aawaaz mein baat bhi na karna jis tarah aapas mein ek doosre ko pukaarte ho, kahin aisa na ho ke tumhaare aamaal barbaad ho jaayein aur tumhein us ka sha'oor bhi na ho
Beshak jo log Rasool-Allah ke saamne apni aawaaz ko dheema rakhte hain yahi woh log hain jin ke dilon ko Khuda ne taqwa ke liye aazma liya hai, aur unhi ke liye maghfirat aur ajr-e-azeem hai
Beshak jo log aap ko hujron ke peechhe se pukaarte hain un ki aksariyat kuch nahin samajhti hai
Aur agar yeh itna sabr kar lete ke aap nikal kar baahar aa jaate to yeh un ke haq mein zyaada behtar hota, aur Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Imaan waalo! Agar koi faasiq koi khabar le kar aaye to us ki tahqeeq karo, aisa na ho ke kisi qaum tak naawaqfiyat mein pahunch jaao aur us ke baad apne iqdaam par sharminda hona pade

Aur yaad rakho ke tumhaare darmiyaan Khuda ka Rasool maujood hai. Yeh agar bahut si baaton mein tumhaari baat maan leta to tum zahmat mein pad jaate, lekin Khuda ne tumhaare liye imaan ko mehboob bana diya hai aur use tumhaare dilon mein aaraasta kar diya hai, aur kufr, fisq aur ma'siyat ko tumhaare liye naapasandeeda qaraar de diya hai, aur dar-haqeeqat yahi log hidaayat-yaafta hain
Yeh Allah ka fazl aur us ki ne'mat hai, aur Allah sab kuch jaanne waala bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Aur agar momineen ke do giroh aapas mein jhagda karein to tum sab un ke darmiyaan sulah karaao. Us ke baad agar ek doosre par zulm kare to sab mil kar us se jang karo jo zyaadati karne waala giroh hai, yahaan tak ke woh bhi hukm-e-Khuda ki taraf waapas aa jaaye. Phir agar palat aaye to adl ke saath islaah kar do aur insaaf se kaam lo, ke Khuda insaaf karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai
Momineen aapas mein bilkul bhai bhai hain, lihaaza apne bhaiyon ke darmiyaan islaah karo aur Allah se darte raho ke shaayad tum par rahm kiya jaaye

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar koi qaum doosri qaum ka mazaaq na udaaye ke shaayad woh us se behtar ho, aur auraton ki bhi koi jamaa'at doosri jamaa'at ka maskhara na kare ke shaayad wahi auratein un se behtar hon. Aur aapas mein ek doosre ko ta'ne bhi na dena aur bure bure alqaab se yaad bhi na karna, ke imaan ke baad badkaari ka naam hi bahut bura hai, aur jo shakhs bhi tauba na kare to samjho ke yahi log dar-haqeeqat zaalimeen hain

Imaan waalo! Aksar gumaanon se ijtinaab karo ke ba'z gumaan gunaah ka darja rakhte hain, aur khabardaar ek doosre ke aib talaash na karo aur ek doosre ki gheebat bhi na karo. Kya tum mein se koi is baat ko pasand karega ke apne murda bhai ka gosht khaaye? Yaqeenan tum use bura samjhoge. To Allah se daro ke beshak Allah bahut bada tauba ka qubool karne waala aur meharbaan hai

Insaano! Hum ne tum ko ek mard aur ek aurat se paida kiya hai aur phir tum mein shaakhein aur qabeele qaraar diye hain taake aapas mein ek doosre ko pehchaan sako. Beshak tum mein se Khuda ke nazdeek zyaada mohtaram wahi hai jo zyaada parhezgaar hai, aur Allah har shai ka jaanne waala aur har baat se baakhabar hai

Yeh badduu Arab kehte hain ke hum imaan le aaye hain. To aap keh dijiye ke tum imaan nahin laaye, balke yeh kaho ke Islam laaye hain, ke abhi imaan tumhaare dilon mein daakhil nahin hua hai. Aur agar tum Allah aur Rasool ki itaa'at karoge to woh tumhaare aamaal mein se kuch bhi kam nahin karega, ke woh bada Ghafoor aur Raheem hai

Saahibaan-e-imaan sirf woh log hain jo Allah aur us ke Rasool par imaan le aaye aur phir kabhi shak nahin kiya, aur us ki raah mein apne maal aur apni jaan se jihaad bhi kiya. Dar-haqeeqat yahi log apne da'wa-e-imaan mein sachche hain
Aap keh dijiye ke kya tum Khuda ko apna deen sikha rahe ho, jab ke woh aasmaan aur zameen ki har shai se baakhabar hai, aur woh kaainaat ki har cheez ka jaanne waala hai

Yeh log aap par ehsaan jataate hain ke Islam le aaye hain. To aap keh dijiye ke hamaare oopar apne Islam ka ehsaan na rakho, yeh Khuda ka ehsaan hai ke us ne tum ko imaan laane ki hidaayat de di hai, agar tum waaqai da'wa-e-imaan mein sachche ho
Beshak Allah aasmaan o zameen ke har ghaib ka jaanne waala aur woh tumhaare tamaam aamaal ka bhi dekhne waala hai
